visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with styled black hair, wearing a white T-shirt, excitedly holds a handful of metallic purple tubes in front of a neutral grey background. (2) Close-up shot of a single metallic purple cosmetic tube with branding printed on it, reflecting the studio lights. (3) A male arm is shown with eight colorful swatches of lip cream ranging from nude pinks to deep reds, with numerical labels #01 to #08 on the side. (4) The man is back on screen holding several tubes, smiling and gesturing towards them while talking with high energy. (5) He swatches a terracotta brick red color on his hand and then applies it to his lips using an applicator wand, showing the texture. (6) Close-up of the man's lips as he meticulously applies the product, showing a matte velvet finish. He then poses with his hand on his cheek, tilting his head. (7) He holds a tube labeled #05 and swatches a deep plum berry color on his hand, displaying the rich pigment against his skin. (8) Close-up of him applying the deep plum shade to his lips, emphasizing the full coverage and matte texture as he moves his mouth. (9) He holds two tubes together, smiling and alternating between the two finished lip looks through quick, rhythmic cuts.
